sentences.text:
Subham Sen And Others vs The State Of West Bengal And
Another on 17 November, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L12 C.R.R.3599 of 2023
17.11.2023
With Bpg.
Cran 1 of 2023 In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973;

Subham Sen and others Versus The State of West Bengal and another Mr. Apalak Basu Mr. Nazir
Ahmed Ms. Sangha Mitra Mridha.
...for the petitioners.
Mr. Kaushik Kundu.
...for the State.
Mr. Indrajit Adhikary.
...for the opposite party no.2.
The present revisional application has been preferred in connection with Muchipara Police Station Case No.175 of 2020 dated 14.09.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
In course of pendency of the present revisional application the parties arrived at a settlement.
Accordingly, a report was called for.

Today, report has been submitted by Sub-Inspector of Police,
Muchipara Police Station which encloses the statement of the de facto complainant, namely Sewita Nandi.
The statement reflects that the lady is not interested to continue with the criminal prosecution as there has been amicable settlement.
Let the report be kept with the record.

Having regard to the report so submitted and the statement so submitted, I am of the opinion that as the dispute arose out of matrimonial discord, further continuance of the same may result in harassment to either of the parties.

Accordingly, all further proceedings of Muchipara Police Station Case No.175 of 2020 dated 14.09.2020 corresponding to G.R. Case No.865 of 2020 including the charge-sheet submitted therein and pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 19th Court, Calcutta be hereby quashed.
